content:
**Aquarium of the Atlantic** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.

Inhabited by the Showmen, the Aquarium of the Atlantic is an impressive underwater attraction that has lost some of its former glory. [1] 

Animals on display in the Aquarium include:

The Expedition mission The Most Sensational Game takes place in here.

This area houses two elevators, one of which can be used to exit the Aquarium to Showman's Pier. In addition, there are some turnstiles and a small box office. Past the turnstiles, stairs lead down to the Great Hall in the east.

Elevators and Box Office in the Lobby

Elevators

Box Office

Turnstiles and stairs

The Great Hall has several fish tanks on two floors, most of which are empty or broken. A life-size whale model in a state of disrepair is hanging from the ceiling. Several doors lead to different sections; the eastern doors to the Beluga Whale Exhibit and the North Observation Lounge, the southern doors to the Petting Pool, Restrooms and Siren Theatre.

Great Hall

Intact fish tank

Eastern doors

Southern doors

Also referred to as the "Beluga Whale Arena," it is a two-story tall, broken and almost emptied basin, that holds the remains of Mary and Marty. Around the basin are several walkways, as well as a sitting area with benches to watch the show. An Armor Workbench is found in a small maintenance area on the southern end of the basin, on the second floor. A terminal with information about the exhibit can be accessed on the basin's outer western end, also on the second floor.

Southwest from the basin is a hallway with maintenance areas, containing a Weapons Workbench and Chemistry Station.

Sitting area overlooking the walkways

Basin overview

Armor Workbench

Terminal

This two-floor lounge is right next to the Beluga Whale Exhibit's northern side, and it overlooks a large basin to the north. The first floor has some sitting benches, while the second floor has a lounging area in the southwestern corner. Rotund windows on both floors allow for an exceptional view on the activities in this lively basin.

Lounge overview

Second floor lounging

Under the sea...

...under the sea!

Accessed through the eastern door on the second floor of the Great Hall, the Petting Pool area consists of two empty basins that used to contain Manta Rays, Starfish and Horseshoe Crabs, with a terminal providing additional information on these creatures. On the western side are two restroom areas. The southern doors lead to the nearby Siren Theatre.

Below the Petting Pools, accessible from the eastern first-floor door from the Great Hall, are an office and a small laboratory.

Petting Pool overview

Small basin

Central basin looking toward the Great Hall

Restroom area

Located south of the Petting Pool is the Siren Theatre, a large auditorium with benches and a stage in front of a big fish basin. The eastern employee room on the second floor has a Tinker's Workbench. A short hallway in the southeastern corner leads to The Shark's Den and its open ocean view.

Siren Theatre overview

Looking west

Stage with basin

Looking north

The Shark's Den is an open room that expands over two floors, with a central round fish tank containing Salmon and Catfish, and several windows allowing for an open ocean view. The first floor has several metal benches, with a western hallway leading to the Siren Theatre and a northern hallway to the Beluga Whale Exhibit. The second floor has two lounges with red sofas.

Shark's Den overview

Stairs to Gift Shop

Sunken vessel

The Gift Shop is a small store along the walkway connecting the Shark's Den and Triton's Den Restaurant.

Looking south

Interior

Entrance to Triton's Restaurant

A two-story restaurant inside a partially flooded underwater cave. The first floor has a few benches, a central kitchen area, as well as an inaccessible exit on the northern wall.

The second floor can be accessed by two separate stairs. It has the restaurant area in the back, which also has a bar and a small stage for performances. In the front is the VIP area, in which Mother Charlotte, the leader of the Showmen, resides.
